download_s2ef_data: download and preprocess the s2ef dataset for a specified split like 200k or all
download_is2re_data: download and extract the is2re dataset into the specified data directory
run_get_data: run the get_data function to download extract and preprocess data for a given task and split
verify_s2ef_count: verify the preprocessed s2ef data row count matches the expected count for a split
cleanup_intermediate_files: cleanup intermediate tar files and directories after data download and preprocessing
